name: research-sweep
description: A self-evolving 'discover' crew: it composes a task-fit team of coverage roles for an information space, fans them out in parallel, dedups, and adversarially verifies their findings into one trustworthy, cited result. The discover counterpart to dev-crew (deliver) and brainstorm-panel (decide).
